title: Urban Gauntlet ratings
summary: How strong the Gauntlet runs in city places.

claims.text: Typical ratings run from 9 in a microchip clean room or a court clerk’s office, through 8 in an inner-city slum or intensive care unit and 7 in a playground or church, to 6 in a large park, art museum or maternity ward.
A typical urban caern has a Gauntlet of 5, a powerful one 4.

title: Trapped Gauntlets
summary: Barriers that strike Garou crossing them.

claims.text: A trapped Gauntlet strikes any Garou who steps sideways, rolling the local Gauntlet rating to hit for a base of one lethal level.
The Gnosis roll to step sideways serves as a dodge, and whatever damage remains is soaked with Willpower rather than Stamina.
If a whole pack crosses at once, every member takes a separate attack but uses the leader’s Gnosis result to dodge.

title: Burgermen
summary: Minor fomori of the O’Tolley’s chain.

claims.text: Like goblins, burgermen change far less than true fomori, and their powers rarely trouble a Crinos Garou, though they can make mischief for Kinfolk investigating a franchise.
Mindless work at O’Tolley’s erodes some employees’ will, costing a point of Willpower each month.
They are meant as dark comic relief, to be used only where they will not spoil a chronicle’s mood.

title: Pleasant Homes
summary: Planned communities with a dark side.

claims.text: Pleasant Homes gated communities with strict covenants are famed as clean, safe places to raise a family, and their residents do better at work, school and health.
Critics call them elitist; residents can be evicted for breaking covenants or failing to pay dues.
Their arrival in a city splits the tribes on whether to help or hinder them.
New Gifts include Climb Like an Ape, Stench and the City, Rooftop Sprint, Gaia’s Toolbox, Weaver’s Eyes, Encrypt, Overclock, Call the City’s Wolves and Beast.
Web Walker, a level three Gift taught by any Weaver-spirit or one with the Scale charm, costs two Gnosis and Charisma + Science at difficulty 7.
With Web Walker the Garou travels the Pattern Web as if on a moon bridge without drawing hostile Weaver-spirits, though the strands may not go where the Garou wants.

title: A rite for city traffic
summary: A minor rite that speeds a car through town.

claims.text: The ritemaster rolls a toy car resembling the vehicle across its dashboard while murmuring to the spirits, then rolls Charisma + Rituals.
Each success lowers the difficulty of moving through traffic by 1, to a minimum of 2, or simply speeds the trip if the Storyteller prefers to narrate.
It helps only with getting through streets quickly, not with stunts.
